_comment: Copy this to house.json and replace every entity id with your own.
This file is the semantic layer: the only place a spoken room name meets
a Home Assistant entity id. Nothing else in the system knows entity ids.
- Room keys are what you say out loud. 'office', not 'office_area_2'.
- Put every other name you use in aliases. A room you call two things
is normal; a room the agent rejects because you used the other name
is a bug in this file, not in your speech.
- Map only what you would ever address by voice. Forty entities is a
working system. Four hundred is a system that guesses.
- When you swap a bulb, edit the line here. Every past conversation
keeps working, because none of them ever named the old entity.
Run `hass_status` after editing. It lists every entity named here that
Home Assistant does not actually have, which is the usual first mistake.
